items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: when he used to play down there with Benny Harris and all those guys.

ctx.x: Everything. Everything. Anything that he wanted to do, he had it all mapped out. I don't know nobody who played like Bird -- or thought like Bird. Especially at that time. They got some guys out here now who can run a lot of notes. But they don't really have much to say about what the situation is. Bird just said about everything. He talked about everything. And knew about everything! He told me about some things I didn't really believe anybody knew that much knowledge about certain things that was going on. But…
We were talking about chord patterns in "How High The Moon" and Bird, and that, of course, leads me to "Ornithology," which Benny Harris wrote...
